***Update 12/28/25
After the 1.7 update, my lobby puts me in games that match others that play like me. I rarely run into a player who wants to shoot me. A much better improvement which I enjoy and NOW give it a thumbs up! Thank you!

***Original Review 
This game has amazing graphics, amazing sound, amazing play style, amazing shock rushes.........but I'm terrible at PVP. Soooo.....

***Buy it if you prefer PVP

***Don't buy it if you prefer PVE

Me personally would have given it a thumbs up if PVE only was an entire seperate option. (Examples like: The Division series, Fallout 76, Age of Empires 4)

200hrs in , i must say that it was a stunning concept that lasted a ways into a'lot of fun. The Arc (Ai that dominates the surface) doesn't really dominate the surface as in they are not sound sensitive to gunfire more that 100m out yet getting in their cone of vision 500m out will trigger them at night only , otherwise they're just cheap toys (regardless they're fun to shoot at). The player base WAS amazing for pvp and pve interaction , now the tide has receded back to angry (from gear loss) type players that are just resorting 3rd party programs for Esp , aim bots and wall hacks. As of this review i feel the beloved Arc Raiders has become plagued with this issue that only the developer team can fix (way more hard core (intensive/intrusuve) Anti-cheat maybe ?

Truly a social experiment of a game. The PvPvE gameplay may not be everyone's cup of tea, but I personally love it! Either shoot first and ask questions later, or work together with other raiders you meet to claim the biggest prizes. Truly a fresh take on the extraction shooter genre, and masterful worldbuilding. Your social skills are just as important as your combat skills, and challenges are tough enough to warrant celebration should you succeed. Truly recommend. If extraction shooters aren't your thing, that's fine, but if you're curious or interested, do it.
